notes:
Facebook sharing now opens the Reel composer and selects the saved MP4 from Recent clips or a saved music video. Sign in on first use, review your video, and choose when to post. The previous button opened the Facebook feed with the file still in Explorer.

The desktop gallery was tested with a real sample MP4 and a controlled browser composer. The attachment matched the original file byte for byte. Live Facebook reached sign-in. Signed-in draft verification was skipped.
